`coassign_calibration_table.csv` is generated by `replication/post/14_calibration_table.R`
from the coverage simulations (`replication/sim/02_coverage_grid.R`) and copied here by
`replication/run_all.sh` (postprocess step). Columns: bin, phat_lo, phat_hi, lower, upper,
n_pairs, width. It is the lookup behind `co_assignment_ci(method = "calibrated")`.
